messages:
eli: hi team, on my first morning trying to finish onboarding. the Company Portal shows "Action required: User Approved MDM" and when i click the link it opens System Settings but there's no profile. FileVault says "Encryption paused" and i'm worried about giving myself admin. any recommended next steps? :confused:

it-support: welcome, eli! can you tell us the Mac model and macOS build? also please don't elevate to admin yourself. we can do a safe short remote session if needed.

eli: macbook-air m2, shows macOS 14.1 (24B69). at the top it showed a message about needing user approval to finish enrollment. i tried the portal reinstall flow and it failed with an error.

it-support: thanks. can you paste the output of these three commands (no need to sudo except where shown)? will help us decide re-enroll vs server push.

```
/usr/sbin/fdesetup status
/usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment
sudo /usr/bin/profiles -P
```

eli: pasted below. i redacted my username in one line.

```
$ /usr/sbin/fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Encryption paused at 8% complete

$ /usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment
Enrollment: user-approved MDM required

$ sudo /usr/bin/profiles -P
Finding all installed configuration profiles
profiles: There are 0 profiles installed.
```

it-support: got it. encryption paused is the key here; macOS sometimes pauses early if upgrade/restore operations were detected. leave the machine plugged in and connected to a stable network for ~30 minutes so the encryption thread can resume. i'm going to attempt a server-side re-send of the enrollment push; if it still shows "user-approved" that means you'll need to manually approve the MDM dialog in System Settings.

mdm-bot: Enrollment push queued (job id: enroll-1770012345). Next attempt in 5 minutes.

maya: hey eli, i'm your onboarding buddy. if it becomes "user-approved" we can screenshare and i'll walk through the System Settings prompt. i also have a step-by-step i can drop here.

eli: thanks maya and team. what does the manual approve flow look like? don't want to click anything sketchy.

it-support: good question. if the enrollment push gets to the device the OS will show a clear system dialog: System Settings -> Profiles -> a pending enrollment banner with the org name and name of the MDM. you'll be prompted to "Approve" the MDM and confirm with your password. we'll be on the call so you can verify the org name before approving. do NOT approve anything that doesn't match "Redwood Inference".

it-support: if you prefer we can also create a one-time admin session via our remote agent so we can run `profiles renew -type enrollment` and `profiles install -type enrollment` from our side without you approving. but that is less ideal than user-approved flow for security reasons.

mdm-bot: Enrollment push status: pending -> delivered -> requires user action (if you see that, please respond here).

eli: enrollment changed to "requires user action". i'm ready for the screenshare.

maya: sending invite now for a 15-min connect. i'll open the onboarding doc and share steps so you can check the org name before tapping approve. :white_check_mark:

it-support: once you approve, you should see profiles list populate. after that run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and check `fdesetup status` again. FileVault should resume and complete. we'll monitor on our side.

eli: on the call and saw the prompt. org shows "Redwood Inference (Device Management)". clicked approve, entered password.

it-support: nice, can you run the two checks now?

```
/usr/sbin/fdesetup status
sudo /usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment
```

eli: output below:

```
$ /usr/sbin/fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Encryption in progress: 19% complete

$ sudo /usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment
Enrollment: enrolled (user-approved)
```

it-support: perfect. encryption resumed and profile is present. we'll keep an eye on it; normally complete in a few hours depending on disk. welcome aboard and glad that worked!

maya: welcome eli!! coffee when you're in SF :tada:

eli: huge thanks everyone. really appreciate the quick help and the walkthrough.
